summary: Change the Node process current working directory and preserve failure/Worker-thread behavior.

requirements.argument: string or Node-supported accepted value per target version
requirements.execution_context: main thread vs Worker known or runtime-represented

target.notes: The helper must update the cwd shared by path.resolve and Node filesystem helpers.

semantics.errors: throws on failure such as missing directory

caveats: Directory existence/access checking belongs to the host operation; do not silently normalize failure to false.

tests.name: normal changes cwd
tests.expected_behavior: changes cwd if parent differs and is accessible
